# odyssey-111 (Odyssey 23.1–96) — review, pass 1

Reviewer pass 1 of 2. `t` untouched (checked unit by unit against the pre-review file); every `l` keeps the line count of its `t`; no `i` contains a newline. Quotation marks checked: eight speeches (5–9, 11–24, 26–31, 35–38, 40–57, 59–68, 70–79, 81–84), each opened with “ on its first unit (all eight carry `mark`) and closed with ” on its last. The packet flags no scansion line, so none was hand-scanned. 23.96 introduces Telemachus' speech, which opens in the next part (not yet drafted, so its first unit could not be checked): no quotation mark stands at 96, and the note now says the speech begins in the next part.

Cross-references checked against the repository: 4.742 and 4.830 (odyssey-021), 4.808 (odyssey-021), 1.64 (odyssey-001), 19.260 (odyssey-094), 6.5 ὑπερηνορεόντων of the Cyclopes (odyssey-027), 1.7 (odyssey-001), 1.64, 4.803, 2.269, 19.393 — see changes. Line numbers within a unit are counted from the unit's `ln`.

## Considered and refused

- **ἐρρώσαντο 23.3** (own-reading): ῥώομαι, aorist middle, "move with speed, dart" (LSJ, Cunliffe) fits; "moved briskly" kept.
- **ὑπερικταίνοντο 23.3**: LSJ and Cunliffe give it no certain sense; the note already says unknown. l "were quickened-above" is the drafter's guess and stays, flagged in the note.
- **ἀτίμων 23.28**: imperfect of ἀτιμάω, verified (see above); not a participle or noun.
- **ἑσταόθ’ 23.46**: ἑσταότα with elision and τ → θ before the rough breathing of οἱ; accusative agreeing with Ὀδυσῆα. Note correct, and it does stand at the head of line 46.
- **μάστακα 23.76**: "mouth, jaws" (LSJ, Autenrieth); ἐπὶ … ἑλών "laying hold on". Kept.
- **παρέξ 23.16**: see change above; LSJ "outside, beyond"; sense of the phrase uncertain, said so.
- **πρὶν δὲ φρένας αἰσίμη ἦσθα, i "until now"**: πρίν "before, formerly"; "until now" is the force in context. Kept.
- **ἀγήνορας "emphatic" (line 9 note)**: it does stand after its noun, separated by the verb; "emphatic" is a mild reading, not a claim about the poem. Kept.
- **κραταίπεδον οὖδας ἔχοντες, i "covering the hard floor"**: ἔχω "hold, occupy"; "covering" is within range. Kept.
- **"waiting to see whether" for ποτιδέγμενος εἴ τι (line 91)**: fine.
- **Telemachus, "rebuked her" (line 96)**: matches table 21.84 (ἐνίπτω with unstated object); "her" is supplied from context as the note says. i begins without "And", whereas 21.84 has "And Antinous"; no rule requires it.
- **Eurycleia's μαῖα vs τροφός** — see changes; the draft's "nurse reserved for τροφός" is refused because τροφός is itself "nurse" (φίλη τροφός → "the dear nurse"), so no clash arises.
- **Other new-renderings rows** (ἀναιδής, ὑπερώϊα, πολύϊδρις, μάργος, ἰφθίμη παράκοιτις, καγχαλόωσα, λωβεύω, σαοφροσύνη, κακὰ εἵματα, ἔα εἰπέμεναι, φίλον τέκος, the 23.69 and 23.96 formulas): checked against the table; ἀναιδής, ὑπερώϊα and ἰφθίμη/παράκοιτις repeat existing rows without conflict and may be dropped at the publish step if the table already covers them; the rest stand.
- **ὑπερηνορεόντων** "over-bold" / "overbearing" follows 6.5 (odyssey-027) and the table; the note's "the Cyclopes in book 6" is verified.
- **1.64 reuse (23.70)**: l and i match the published unit except the final punctuation, which `t` requires.
- **19.260 reuse (23.19)**: l and i match the published second line; "also spoken by Penelope" verified.
- **23.49**: Murray has no line 49; ln values 48, 50, 51 correct; the note stands.
- **Paragraph marks** (¶ at 1, 5, 32, 35, 39, 58, 69): `p` flags match.

# Pass 2

Reviewer pass 2 of 2. `units.json` re-read in full against the packet's Greek (labels in notes, `l`, `i`, quotation marks). Mechanical checks by script: the `t` fields rejoin to exactly the packet's 95 lines (no `t` touched); every `l` has as many lines as its `t`; no `i` has a newline; “ opens and ” closes each of the eight speeches (5–8, 11–24, 26–29, 35, 40–56, 59–67, 70–78, 81–83), with `mark` on each opening unit. `gloss.json` has exactly the keys of `novel-forms.json` plus `__broaden__`; every entry is under 230 characters, has the ' — ' shape, uses ’ only, and carries no line number. Every novel-form parse and each of the six `__broaden__` additions (κακὸν, μακρὸν, τί, εἰσαφίκοιτο, ἔα, ὄψει) was checked against its line. The 96 unit has no closing ” (and no opening one); its note says the speech begins in the next part; odyssey-112 is not drafted, so nothing further to check.

## Considered and refused (pass 2)

- **ἐπιβῆτον 23.52 (dual subjunctive)**: 2 dual aorist subjunctive, ἀμφοτέρω as subject; the construction is disputed (ἦτορ as subject or accusative of respect) and the note already says "the grammar of the phrase is loose". Kept; gloss "you two may take hold of" agrees.
- **ἀτίμων 23.28**: imperfect 3 pl. (ἀτίμαον > ἀτίμων); a participle would be ἀτιμῶν, a different accent and sense. Kept.
- **ἀνέγειρεν 23.22 (gloss "impf.")**: the form could also be an unaugmented aorist; the context is a past unreal condition either way and "wakened" covers both. Kept.
- **κατάβηθι gloss "ending -θι (= Attic κατάβηθι)"**: true though redundant; the Attic imperative is the same. Kept.
- **ἄνεω gloss ("fem. nom. sg. in use")**: ἄνεως is of one ending in Attic and epic; true. Kept.
- **ἐπέβησαν gloss "weak (causative)"**: the transitive sense with σαοφροσύνης is the one in the line; the intransitive reading would give "stepped upon", which does not fit ἐπέβησαν + χαλιφρονέοντα. Kept.
- **ἰφθίμη "it sits oddly here"** (line 90 note): editorial remark, harmless. Kept.
- **ἀνεγείρεις "in line 16"** (line 5 note) and **ἔγρεο "in line 5"** (line 15 note): cross-references checked against the packet; both right.
- **μακρὸν first reading "far, loudly" and the other pre-existing __broaden__ readings**: not rewritten (runbook: never rewrite an existing entry otherwise).
- **Hand scansion**: the packet flags no line; none scanned.

## Counts (pass 2)

High 2 (ἰάνθης in units.json and in gloss.json, one fault); medium 2; low 5 (counting each table row once: high 2 rows, medium 2, low 5); refused 10.
